title: 打到一半被埋住了
subtitle: 一块化石里的两只恐龙
character: wearing a brick red t-shirt, khaki shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen line work with light watercolour washes, sand ochre, brick red and warm grey

pages.zh:
一块石头里
卡着两只恐龙，
一只咬住对方的胳膊，
另一只的爪子
钩在它脖子上。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy in a museum beside one slab of rock holding two dinosaur skeletons locked together, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, his mouth open in surprise.

pages.zh:
一只是伶盗龙，
两条腿，尖爪子。
一只是原角龙，
四条腿走路，
嘴巴像鹦鹉。

伶盗龙后脚上
有一根大爪子，
平时翘着不落地，
要用的时候
才扳下来。

那根大爪子
就卡在原角龙
脖子那块地方。
那儿有大血管。
它知道往哪儿下手。

原角龙也没闲着。
它的嘴像一把钳子，
死死咬住了
伶盗龙的右胳膊，
骨头都咬断了。
pages.scene: Close view of one parrot-beaked dinosaur's beak clamped tightly on the forearm of a smaller two-legged dinosaur on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
谁也不松开。
一个钩着脖子，
一个咬着胳膊，
就这样僵在那儿，
动不了了。

就在这时候，
旁边的沙丘塌了。
几吨重的沙子
一下子压下来，
把它们盖住。
pages.scene: A steep sand dune collapsing and pouring down over two dinosaurs locked together on the ground on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
沙子埋得太快，
它们来不及倒下，
也没被别人拖走。
所以打架的样子
原封不动留到今天。

八千万年以后，
有人在蒙古的沙漠里
挖到了这块石头。
一挖出来
就看呆了。
pages.scene: Two dinosaur skeletons still locked together, lying half uncovered in desert sand on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
伶盗龙其实不大，
只有火鸡那么高，
身上还长着羽毛，
站直了身子
才到我胸口。

那谁赢了呢？
谁也没赢。
两只一起被埋，
一起变成石头，
到现在还没分开。
pages.scene: Close view of one large sharp claw on the back foot of a small two-legged dinosaur, still hooked into the neck of a larger four-legged dinosaur, on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我趴在玻璃上看。
它们打到一半，
沙子就下来了。
八千万年过去，
还是那个姿势。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy with both hands pressed flat on a glass case, two dinosaur skeletons locked together inside it, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, thoughtful.
